title: Encoding a basis vector
statement: Let $\ell$ be a positive integer, and let $j$ be a coordinate in $\{0,\ldots,\ell-1\}$. Under the linear encoding of the degree-$\ell$ binary extension field by its coordinates in a basis, the field element corresponding to the $j$th basis vector is sent to the coordinate vector that is $1$ at $j$ and $0$ elsewhere.
